description.en: The phone number. You can view the phone number on the <props="china">[**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[Channel Management](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > **Manage** > **WABA Management** > **Phone Number Management** page.

descriptions.zh:
- 您可调用此接口获取号码验证状态，也可在
<props="china">[通道管理](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props>
<props="intl">[**通道管理**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props>>**管理**>**WABA管理**>**号码管理**界面查看号码验证状态。

- 在调用此接口前，请确保您WABA下已新增号码，且已提交号码验证。

- 若您WABA下没有新增的号码，请调用[GetChatappVerifyCode](~~600746~~)、[ChatappVerifyAndRegister](~~600770~~)接口获取验证码校验并注册号码。

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to retrieve the verification status of a phone number. You can also view the status on the <props="china">[Channel Management](https://chatapp.console.aliyun.com/ChannelsManagement)</props><props="intl">[**Channel Management**](https://chatapp.console.alibabacloud.com/CustomerList)</props> > **Manage** > **WABA Management** > **Phone Number Management** page.

- Before calling this operation, add a phone number to your WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) and submit it for verification.

- If you have not added a phone number to your WABA, call the [GetChatappVerifyCode](~~600746~~) and [ChatappVerifyAndRegister](~~600770~~) APIs to obtain a verification code and register the number.

This operation allows a maximum of 10 requests per second per account. Excess requests are throttled, which may affect your business. Stay within the specified limit.
